anchor.line: But I've got a love, she is my anchor
stanza: For you know that life is never ending
But sometimes the miles just seem too long to try
But I've got a love, she is my anchor
She held me down and saved my soul
So take the blood and hate and anger and let it go
Devotion strong but tender
Devotion dark and cold
Devotion like an anchor
Swinging from my soul
I used to weigh the distance
I used to miss my cues
I used to say ‘I love you’
Then wonder who I’m talking to

anchor.line: Heave ahead round and we'll anchor
stanza: Wives are waiting on the pier head
Gazing seaward from the heather
Heave ahead round and we'll anchor
Ere the sun sets on Mingulay
Jack, he is a banker
And Jane, she is a clerk
And both of them save their monies
When they come home from work
Ooh, they be sittin' down by the fire
Oh, the radio does play
The classical music, said Jim, the 'March of the Wooden Soldiers'
All you protest kids, you can hear Jack say, get ready
Sweet Jane, come on, baby
Sweet Jane, sweet Jane
